title: Improving Equity in Health Modeling with GPT4-Turbo Generated Synthetic Data: A Comparative Study

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating disparities in predictive machine learning model performance (measured via AUROC and AUPRC) across different racial and ethnic groups (Asian, Black, Hispanic, and White) on clinical prediction tasks, and assessing the effectiveness of mitigating these performance gaps by augmenting underrepresented minority groups with GPT4-Turbo generated synthetic data.
